title: Four governed access patterns help teams consume, build, share, and experiment with enterprise data
framing_statement: Start with the needs of each user group. Define approved access paths, accountable owners, and operating controls before broadening access to the platform.
bi_bullets: and documented semantic models for recurring reporting and performance analysis
Review refresh frequency, access rules, and reuse needs with the teams consuming each data product
developer_bullets: Provide approved SQL, notebook, and development environments matched to workload and user responsibilities
Use version control, reusable code, peer review, and environment promotion rules for changes
sharing_bullets: Select approved APIs, files, and sharing patterns for exchanging data with existing enterprise services
Document purpose, access permissions, lineage, and support ownership for each exchange
ai_bullets: Create controlled workspaces for exploration, feature development, and evaluation of proposed AI use cases
Require model review, monitoring, capacity planning, and an approved promotion path before production use
